::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [?1871]  
**Manuscript:** MS location unknown.  This fragment quoted in Mare and Percival, [<i>Victorian Best-Seller</i>](other_books/otherbook_598.qmd), 215.

There seems so much to do here, and with an old mind like mine, it is difficult to take in fresh impressions.[^1]

---

[^1]: ‘When two years after the French visit, the Heathcotes asked Charlotte Yonge to winter in Rome with them, she declined on the grounds that . . .’  Mare and Percival, *Victorian Best-Seller*, 215.
